about: Touched-path → test-suite map, read by `botq test-map`. First matching rule wins; an unmapped path fails the resolver loud. Commands run from the repo root.

rules.why: editing the map re-lints its own completeness over every tracked file
everything else is the app: test.js covers the node-testable synth/scheme math, dom-test.sh covers the in-browser half (boot, hash decode, round-trip) — both cheap, so no finer scoping
